subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers accept this narrow Control UI chat picker accessibility affordance after resolving the current conflict while leaving the broader linear workspace request open?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but it has a protected maintainer label, user-facing accessibility wording, and only partially overlaps a larger product-direction issue.

options.title: Land narrow picker slice
options.body: Approve the visible row numbers and accessible option names after branch refresh and required checks, without treating this as the full linear workspace solution.

options.title: Request UX wording changes
options.body: Ask for different visible ordinal treatment or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Hold this PR until the larger linear persistent workspace direction is decided, accepting that the smaller picker improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land narrow picker slice
recommendation.body: Approve the visible row numbers and accessible option names after branch refresh and required checks, without treating this as the full linear workspace solution.
